<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_script"><sys_transform_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><map display_value="SBOMs Transform Map">e00e397987e42e50322e642e8bbb35a0</map><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function runTransformScript(source, map, log, target) {
    var importSetId = source.importSetId; //undefined ?
	log.info("importSetId :" + importSetId);

    var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_transform_map');
    gr.addQuery('name', 'SBOM Docs Tranform Map');
    gr.query();

   if (gr.next()) {
       var transformMapSysId = gr.sys_id;
	   log.info("transformMapSysId :" + transformMapSysId);
   }  

    var transformer = new GlideImportSetTransformer()
        .setTransformMap(transformMapSysId) // sys_id drugiej mapy transformacji
        .setImportSetID(importSetId) // Przekaż IMPORT_SET_SYS_ID
        .setSkipExisting(false) // Pomijaj istniejące rekordy
        .transformAll(); // Uruchom drugą transformację
})(source, map, log, target);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_transform_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-04-01 14:01:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>a5a17acb8728a210322e642e8bbb35cd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onComplete</sys_name><sys_package display_value="SBOM Manager Lite" source="x_erace_sbom">2975030f87971e10322e642e8bbb3555</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="SBOM Manager Lite">2975030f87971e10322e642e8bbb3555</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_script_a5a17acb8728a210322e642e8bbb35cd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-04-01 15:55:35</sys_updated_on><when>onComplete</when></sys_transform_script></record_update>
